paite: Paul, Jesu Khrist leh misi lak a kipan a kaithoupa, Pa Pathian ziak a sawltak, mihing sawlkhiak hilou, mihing vang a leng hi sam lou,
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

paite: leh ka kiang a unau om tengtengte'n, Galatia gam a saptuamte kiang ah:
english: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

paite: Pa Pathian leh i Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: Ama'n i Pathian leh Pa deihdan in, tulai khovel giloutak lak a ahon suahtaksak theihna ding in i khelhnate a ding in amah mah ahong kipeta hi.
english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

paite: Pathian kiang ah thupina tangtawn in om hen, Amen.
english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Khrist hehpihna ziak a nou hon sampa huchi guih a tanchinhoih tuam lam a na kisuansan uh lamdang ka sa hi.
heading: Tangthupha Dang Om Lou
english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

paite: Tanchinhoih dang om ahi kei a; noumau hon hihbuai in Khrist tanchinhoih hihlamdan ut kuate hiam a-om uh ahi zaw hi.
english: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

paite: Himahleh koumau hiam, van a kipan hong suk angel nangawn in leng, tanchinhoih na kiang ua ka gensa pen lou ngal uh tanchinhoih dang himhim hon na hilhta a-om uleh hamsiat in om uhen.
english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

paite: Tuma a ka gen bang un, tua gen nawn ding ka hi. Tanchinhoih na muh pen lou ngal uh, tanchinhoih dang kuapeuh in nou ahon hilhleh hamsiat in om uhen.
english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

paite: Ahihleh tu in mihing maipha hia ka zon, Pathian a? Ahihkeileh mihing ahi maw lungtaisak ka tup? Mihing ana lungtaisak lel hi taleng, Khrist sikha ka hi kei ding hi.
english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, ka tanchinhoih gen pen mihing a pan ahi kei chih ka hon theisak hi.
heading: Paul Tanchinhoih Gen
english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

paite: Mihing kiang a kipan a ka muh leng ahi kei, mi hon hilh leng ka hi sam kei, Jesu Khrist kilakna ziak amu ka hi zaw hi.
english: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

paite: Judate sabiakdan a nidanglai ka omdan na thei khinta ngal ua, huchi a Pathian saptuamte nakpitak a sawi in sukchimih ka na sawm gige hi.
english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

paite: Huan ka pipute thugousiah tung a phatuam ka ngaih tuankhol ziak in Judate sabiakdan lam ah ka chipihte lak a ka khanvual tampite ka na khengta hi.
english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

paite: Ka nu gilsung a kipan a hon hihtuampa leh ahehpihna ziak a hon sampa Pathian in,
english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

paite: Zentelte lak a ka hilhtheihna ding a, ama Tapa lungkimtak a keimah a akilaksak lai in, sa leh sisan toh kidong lou in,
english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

paite: sawltak ka hih ma a sawltak ana hisate kiang a Jerusalem a hohtou tuan lou in, Arabia gam ah ka paimang pah a; huan Damaskas ah ka kik nawnta hi.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

paite: Kum thum abei nung in Kifas veh ding in Jerusalem ah ka va hohtou a, akiang ah ni sawm-le-nga ka taam hi.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

paite: Sawltak dangte, Toupa unau Jakob kia lou ngal kuamah ka mu kei hi.
english: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

paite: Na kiang ua ka thugelhte ngai dih ua, Pathian mitmuh ah ka zuau kei hi.
english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

paite: Huai nung in Siria leh Silisia gamte ah ka pai hi.
english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

paite: Judia gam a saptuam, Khrist a omte meltheih ka hi nai kei lai hi,
english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

paite: "Tuma lam a khatvei ginna thu sukchimih tum a hon sawipa'n tu in huai thu agen zawta," chih mi gen kia aza uhi.
english: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

paite: Huan keimah ziak in Pathian apahtawita uhi.
english: So they glorified God in me.
